build_BeamSearch: build a BeamSearch decoder that performs standard beam search decoding on log-probabilities for sequence generation
build_LexicallyConstrainedBeamSearch: build a LexicallyConstrainedBeamSearch decoder that enforces ordered or unordered lexical constraints during beam search
build_DiverseBeamSearch: build a DiverseBeamSearch decoder that decodes diverse solutions using Hamming diversity penalty across groups
build_Sampling: build a Sampling decoder that uses top-k or top-p nucleus sampling for stochastic sequence generation
build_DiverseSiblingsSearch: build a DiverseSiblingsSearch decoder that applies diversity rate penalty to sibling hypotheses in beam search
